{"id": "12:47/q01", "question": "What do the seven years of sowing signify in the king's dream?", "turns_on": "Whether the dream's images primarily forecast agricultural conditions or prescribe the work and storage needed for famine.", "positions": [{"id": "12:47/q01/p1", "position": "Seven fertile years, followed by seven years of drought or famine.", "reasons": "Al-Thaʿlabī, al-Kashshāf, al-Qurṭubī, al-Rāzī, al-Ālūsī and Study Quran identify fat cows and green ears with fertile years, lean cows and dry ears with famine. {"id": "12:47/q22", "question": "What legal principle does the storage policy illustrate?", "turns_on": "", "positions": [{"id": "12:47/q22/p1", "position": "Public benefit preserves religion, life, intellect, lineage, and property; preventing their loss is also benefit.", "reasons": "Al-Qurṭubī derives these five interests from the verse, treating their preservation as benefit and their loss as harm."}]}
{"id": "12:47/q23", "question": "Why do revealed laws address worldly interests?", "turns_on": "", "positions": [{"id": "12:47/q23/p1", "position": "Worldly guidance enables knowledge and worship of God and happiness in the afterlife; it is divine grace.", "reasons": "Al-Qurṭubī attributes to Sunni authorities the qualification that God grants this care by grace, not by an obligation owed by God."}]}
